newsitem.title: CROATIA: PRESS DIGEST - Croatian weekly Tjednik - Aug 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Croatian weekly Tjednik - Aug 14.

text.p: Following are highlights of the leading stories in Croatian weekly Tjednik. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tourism analysis: With 912 million kuna in accumulated losses, added to other woes of the tourist trade, it may have been less than easy to welcome guests with an optimistic smile this summer.

- Political commentary by M. Jergovic: A flurry of C.V. rewriting is to be expected as prominent members of society seek to hide their past after President Tudjman in his inaugural address vowed to get rid of the "remnants of communism". Tudjman was himself a communist party member of long standing and so were his wife Ankica and son Miroslav.

- Although the judiciary and police authorities deny the existence of organised crime in Croatia, the actual situation with contract killings, drug trafficking in cafes and advertisements offering services in redeeming stolen cars proves the opposite.

- Foreign exchange market: Traditionally using the German mark as a currency for their savings, most Croats remain faithful to it despite its decline against the dollar. -- Zagreb newsroom +385 1 455 7075
